records.original_stem:
A pharmacist is reviewing incoming prescriptions in Massachusetts. Any electronic-prescribing exception mentioned below is valid; it does not waive other controlled-drug requirements. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_option_text: An authorized agent independently selects a different drug and dose while transmitting the practitioner’s order.
A.finding_ko: Agent의전달 권한은 prescriber가정한order의전달이다. 약물·용량을 독립 선택하여 새 치료를 정할 권한이 아니다.

B.original_option_text: A pharmacist counts an EPCS and its paper replacement as separate authorizations without checking whether one replaces the other.

C.original_option_text: A pharmacist distinguishes a scanned paper prescription from an originally generated EPCS.
C.finding_ko: 스캔한종이는전자저장되어도원래생성·서명·전송된EPCS가아니다. 발행 형식에 맞는 요건을 따른다.

D.original_option_text: A practitioner replaces the actual issue date with a future date so that a later fill appears to be newly issued.

records.case_application_ko: 각 선택지는 별개 기록이며 명시된 format·사유·기산점을 유지해 판단했다. 스캔한종이는전자저장되어도원래생성·서명·전송된EPCS가아니다. 발행 형식에 맞는 요건을 따른다.
records.blocker: 저자 검토상 기존 key가 공식 근거와 일치하고 실제 법률·정답 결함을 확인하지 못했다. 모델 반복은 자동 실패로 세지 않는다. 독립 legal/realism 감사·canonical 등록·release는 별도 미충족이다.

records.original_stem:
A pharmacist is reviewing incoming prescriptions in Massachusetts. Any electronic-prescribing exception mentioned below is valid; it does not waive other controlled-drug requirements. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_option_text: A pharmacy distinguishes an inpatient immediate-administration order from an outpatient discharge prescription.

B.original_option_text: A pharmacist treats a scanned paper prescription as original EPCS because the image is stored in the pharmacy database.

C.original_option_text: A pharmacist replaces the prescribed controlled drug with a different ingredient and records the change as a clerical correction.

D.original_option_text: A pharmacy treats a valid paper-format exception as permission to omit the remaining controlled-prescription requirements.

records.original_stem:
Two Massachusetts retail pharmacies receive requests to move prescriptions. Both have appropriate registrations; the options specify original format, prior dispensing, and the intended transfer method. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_option_text: A pharmacy transfers an unfilled paper alprazolam prescription as EPCS after entering it into the dispensing computer.

B.original_option_text: At the patient’s request, pharmacists transfer a never-filled CII EPCS once, electronically and without altering its contents.

C.original_option_text: A receiving pharmacy assumes the initial transfer creates five new refills even when the prescriber authorized only one.

D.original_option_text: A pharmacist uses the never-filled EPCS rule to move an already partially dispensed CII remainder.

records.original_stem:
A Massachusetts pharmacist reviews outpatient labels and proposed substitutions. Assume the prescriber’s intended ingredient, strength, dosage form, and route are known. Each option describes a separate work-queue record. Assume all other prerequisites are satisfied; judge the action and facts actually stated, not an unstated exception.

Which ONE proposed handling is supported by the applicable requirements?

A.original_option_text: A pharmacist concludes that any product sold by the same company is the authorized generic of the prescribed brand.

B.original_option_text: A pharmacist treats a private note to the inventory department as the required patient notification after biological substitution.

C.original_option_text: A pharmacy treats the statutory ten-characters-per-inch wording as an automatic requirement for ten-point type.

D.original_option_text: A pharmacist preserves the actual prescribing practitioner in internal verification records while using an eligible protected-care practice name on the patient label.
D.finding_ko: Acts2025c16§7은provider요청시연방법예외에저촉되지않는보호진료label에practice명을쓰도록하며§27에따라2026-01-01시행이다. 이label예외는실제처방자·권한확인·기록요건을폐지하지 않는다. 미반영 General Laws §21 화면과 해당 session law를 함께 읽는다.
